title: Rust Audiophile Player — Product and Engineering Specification
status: Scoped playback tested on Linux and macOS; prepared PCM graphs pass Linux integration; native graph qualification and release gates remain partial

q25.release_plan_basis: Proposed engineering baseline; not a reconstruction of missing answer text.

requirements.requirement: Own the product model, session orchestration and DSP graph in Rust; keep UI and transport libraries outside the real-time engine.
Expose one semantic command/query/event contract to GUI, CLI, local API and UniFFI clients.
Run locally first with one authoritative engine owner per output; support embedding and a local standalone host without requiring a remote server.
Maintain separate typed PCM-preserving, floating-point DSP and DSD payload paths. Never process DoP transport words as PCM.
Use bounded preallocated audio buffers and keep allocation, deallocation, blocking I/O, locks with unbounded waits and foreign callbacks out of the audio processing path.
Provide deterministic offline rendering, a virtual output and fault-injection harnesses before qualifying real hardware.
Define schema and control compatibility rules; reject unsupported features rather than accepting inert settings.
Play local WAV, FLAC and AIFF with open-file/open-folder and a basic ordered queue; preserve originals without retagging or reorganizing.
Implement play, pause, resume, stop and capability-aware seek with audible position distinct from decode position.
Deliver sample-continuous gapless local playback for qualified compatible lossless tracks, with no inserted, duplicated or dropped frames.
Maintain DSP state across compatible track boundaries and explicitly negotiate or interrupt incompatible rate/format transitions.
Allow only one active source per local zone. A source handoff stops the prior session and invalidates its buffered audio and commands.
Persist the local queue and recover into a paused/muted state after a crash; never autonomously resume into an unverified output.
Support qualified DSF and uncompressed DFF playback through DoP; native DSD is enabled only on specifically tested backend/device combinations.
Add optional fades, crossfade, ReplayGain, shuffle and repeat with transformations visible and strict preservation policies enforced.
Implement an interoperable UPnP AV renderer with discovery, transport, connection capabilities, rendering control and truthful event/state reporting.
Integrate the Sendspin player role against a pinned protocol/SDK revision and a named Music Assistant test version; advertise only usable formats and controls.
Schedule Sendspin audio against the protocol timeline, account for processing/output delay exactly once and qualify drift correction on independent clocks.
Keep original source metadata, received transport format and actual output format separate. Report upstream processing as unknown when it is not evidenced.
Treat Music Assistant as authoritative for its queue and library; route supported control actions upstream without creating a competing queue.
Apply bounded parsing, trusted-origin fetch rules, session epochs and pairing/authorization policies to all network sources.
Implement tested macOS Core Audio and Linux direct-ALSA output adapters with device discovery and exact negotiated-format reporting.
Offer a Linux system/shared playback route compatible with the qualified PipeWire desktop setup; do not label an unverified shared route bit-perfect.
Track advertised, opened, exercised and independently measured device capabilities separately, keyed to a device/backend/OS environment.
Expose output clock position, buffering and latency with measurement basis and unknown values; invalidate stale timing after route changes.
Never silently reroute to a different physical output after unplug, busy-device or format failure. Pause/mute and report recovery choices.
Apply explicit strict, compatible and manual negotiation policies; conversions and rejected overrides must be explained.
Compile a validated typed feed-forward graph with reorderable nodes, branches, merges and channel matrices; reject unsupported cycles and incompatible domains.
Provide f64 PCM gain, parametric EQ, convolution and selectable resampling configurations behind interchangeable node implementations.
Keep sample-rate changes explicit and validate filter coefficients, channel layouts and processing-rate domains before activation.
Track algorithmic latency and align parallel branches at merges where required; do not equate alignment with arbitrary phase correction.
Prepare graph changes off the audio thread, commit atomically against a revision, retire old resources off-thread and preserve the last working graph on failure.
Import a documented REW text/CamillaDSP-filter subset, AutoEq parametric presets and correction FIR WAVs with validation and provenance.
Reject unapproved correction-IR rate changes, unidentified measurement IRs, non-finite coefficients and resource-exhausting graphs.
Implement quality-focused, balanced and low-latency policies as declared constraints; never silently remove correction or change sound to meet a latency target.
Add PCM-to-DSD, DSD processing, modulators, advanced noise shaping and DAC-specific correction only behind dedicated validation gates.
Centralize mute, startup level, volume limits and route-change protection below all control surfaces; fixed output requires explicit arming.
Validate headroom and monitor non-finite samples and clipping; any protective sample alteration must change the reported fidelity status.
Support fixed, hardware and software volume as separate per-profile modes, with known gain stages and no double attenuation or assumed hardware readback.
Refuse PCM gain/EQ/limiting on DSD payloads; use verified DSD-aware mute/transition behavior and never reinterpret DSD as audible PCM.
Use local-user authorization for local IPC; make remote administration opt-in, paired and encrypted; redact secrets in diagnostics.
Bound media/import/API resources, fuzz untrusted parsers and enforce safe failure without automatic protective-filter bypass.
Provide versioned named profiles referencing graph, source policy, output policy, volume policy and latency mode.
Support deterministic exact-device associations and manual listening-setup selection; do not infer headphones attached to an unchanged DAC.
Export/import self-contained profile packages with content hashes, source/license metadata and no auto-application of dangerous gain changes.
Add context rules with explicit priority, bounded evaluation, preview and an explanation of why a profile was selected.
Expose typed commands, snapshots, capability queries and sequenced events; commands return receipts rather than pretending accepted means applied.
Use expected revisions and explicit session/device targets for configuration changes; reject stale mutations and deduplicate retried commands.
Ship macOS and Linux GUIs covering source, playback, device, profile, DSP configuration, signal path and diagnostics without requiring a visual node editor.
Ship scriptable CLI controls with structured output, stable errors and bounded waits through the same service contract.
Ship versioned UniFFI bindings with Swift integration tests and Kotlin smoke tests; do not transport per-buffer audio through foreign UI callbacks.
Make slow/disconnected controllers harmless to playback, with bounded event queues, gap markers and snapshot recovery.
Report requested, resolved and observed source/graph/device state separately; model preservation, transformations and verification scope as independent fields.
Provide a signal-path inspector with node identity, versions, formats, gain, latency, bypass state and conversion reasons.
Record underruns, deadline misses, queue depths, CPU/latency summaries, clipping and source/graph epochs without blocking audio.
Export a redacted reproducible diagnostic/evidence bundle tied to build, environment, fixtures, graph and exact test outcomes.
Add FFT/spectrogram, impulse-response inspection, level-matched A/B and distortion analysis with digital versus acoustic measurement provenance.
Treat headphone/room corrections as graph assets with model, measurement source, target, preamp, sample rate and provenance.
Implement a guided phone measurement workflow using local capture, authenticated transfer, quality checks and acoustic timing/drift alignment.
Support calibrated measurement microphones, calibration files and multi-position capture in the same measurement project model.
Generate bounded correction filters with explicit confidence, boost/energy limits and validation measurements; never equate uncalibrated phone capture with reference measurement.
Reuse the same engine/control model in a remote headless host and lightweight output endpoints; define transport and clocks before promising synchronized multi-output.
Add CLAP, VST3 and LV2 hosting incrementally with plugin identity/state, latency budgets, scanner isolation and tested crash behavior.
Add Windows, iOS and Android playback clients, a lightweight local library and multichannel hardware only through platform-specific qualification.
License first-party code MIT and maintain an audited dependency/license/feature inventory; preserve third-party notices and applicable source obligations.
Pin candidate dependencies and protocol revisions; isolate CamillaDSP library API changes and treat Sendspin Rust SDK maturity as a qualification question.
Deliver installable desktop apps plus Rust library, standalone local host, CLI and documented control API from one versioned workspace.
Gate release on traceable acceptance evidence, real macOS/Linux hardware coverage, bounded-resource stress tests and all in-scope safety cases.
Keep basic local playback offline and account-free; make telemetry upload and asset redistribution explicit opt-ins.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Architecture and dependency spike
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Virtual output; selected crate/protocol revisions recorded.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Render a known PCM fixture offline; prepare one filter through each candidate adapter; build the workspace on macOS and Linux.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Stable product types do not expose upstream types; feature/license inventory and candidate decisions are committed; no unqualified backend is marked supported.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Control-surface equivalence
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Same engine version, fixture, output and starting state for Rust, CLI, API and Swift clients; Kotlin binding smoke harness.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Run equivalent play/pause/seek/profile/graph commands and inspect normalized state and receipts.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Identical semantic results and policy enforcement; unsupported operations give the same typed errors; FFI lifetimes/cancellation pass.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Single output owner
acceptance_scenarios.setup: GUI owner and standalone-host executable on the same machine.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Start a second owner, attach multiple controllers, disconnect the GUI and deliberately stop the host.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Second instance attaches or fails clearly; no competing device opens; documented host lifecycle and clean shutdown.

acceptance_scenarios.title: PCM preservation and strict refusal
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Integer fixtures covering signed limits, low-order bits and supported rates/widths; virtual capture and qualified real route.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Decode, bypass processing, pack/unpack output and compare numeric sample payloads; request an unsupported format and enable software gain.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Zero sample/frame differences on preservation paths; strict mode rejects required alteration; lossless container padding is distinguished from quantization.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Real-time discipline
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Instrumented allocator, callback/DSP thread markers and slow foreign observers.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Warm the engine, then play, seek, replace graphs, disconnect observers and induce diagnostic pressure.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: No real-time allocation/deallocation, forbidden blocking calls or FFI callback work; no playback dependence on observer speed.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Repeatable fault harness
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Deterministic virtual clock, bounded input source and controllable output.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Inject short writes, underruns, backend failure, malformed chunks and stale-generation packets using fixed seeds.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Repeatable event sequences and output hashes; failures terminate or recover according to documented policy.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Schema compatibility
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Current, older supported and future-version profile/command fixtures.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Load and round-trip supported data; submit unknown required nodes/fields and malformed versions.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Supported migration preserves meaning; unsupported required features fail explicitly; original data remains recoverable.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Minimal local playback
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Owned/generated WAV, FLAC and AIFF fixtures, a large directory and a missing file.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Open one file, append a directory, reorder the queue and compare source-file hashes before/after.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Correct tracks and order without modifying source files; bounded metadata work; missing files produce visible per-item errors.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Transport semantics and recovery
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Known-duration fixture, variable output buffering and seek-capable/streaming inputs.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Pause/resume/seek repeatedly; inspect audible vs decoded position; restart after abrupt termination.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Position follows output accounting; seeks flush stale data; unsupported seeks reject; restart restores queue paused/muted, not audibly playing.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Gapless continuity with DSP state
acceptance_scenarios.setup: One generated signal split losslessly into multiple files, plus the unsplit reference.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Play both through bypass, EQ and convolution; compare aligned captures including the join and final filter tail.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Equal sample count and no artificial discontinuity; state is not reset at compatible joins; final tail is drained exactly once.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Incompatible track transition
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Queue containing changed rates, channel layouts and PCM/DSD modes.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Play transitions under strict and compatible policies with backend reopen delays.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Documented muted reconfiguration or explicit conversion, truthful discontinuity reporting and no false universal-gapless claim.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Exclusive source ownership
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Local, UPnP and Sendspin adapters with tagged test audio and delayed packets.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Start each source over another, then deliver old-source chunks and commands after the new session starts.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: One owner; prior source stopped/flushed; old generations rejected; setting metadata alone does not steal ownership.

acceptance_scenarios.title: DSD transport and safety
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Generated DSF/uncompressed DFF payloads, software DoP parser and at least one qualified hardware route on each launch OS.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Pack/unpack DoP; switch PCM/DSD; pause/stop; inject underrun; request software attenuation and DSP on the passthrough path.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: DSD payload preserved; markers and mute transitions validated; incompatible processing refused; no DSD bytes emitted as ordinary PCM. Native DSD advertised only where separately exercised.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Output change and crash safety
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Two physical outputs, one fixed-output profile and one software-volume profile.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Unplug active DAC, change defaults, fail reopen, restart process and switch profiles with different saved levels.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: No silent reroute or unexpected level increase; fixed output remains unarmed until explicit approval; state and corrective action are visible.

acceptance_scenarios.title: UPnP interoperability
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Pinned Music Assistant version, another independent controller and network fault proxy.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Discover; set URI; play/pause/seek/stop; change volume; subscribe/unsubscribe; test next-URI and renderer restart.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Correct advertised services and events; implemented next-URI behaves correctly or is clearly unsupported; no claim of third-party certification.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Sendspin interoperability
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Pinned spec, SDK and Music Assistant revisions; PCM and FLAC fixtures.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Pair/discover, negotiate roles/formats, play, change formats, clear/end streams, reconnect and control upstream playback.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Protocol-conformant lifecycle; only supported formats advertised; no stale buffered replay; queue stays authoritative on server.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Clock drift and latency accounting
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Two independent output clocks; instrumented simultaneous capture; declared jitter/drift and DSP-latency cases.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Run long synchronized playback; change latency mode/FIR; inject jitter, a late chunk and an underrun; quantify output offsets.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Meet pinned protocol limits in the declared operating envelope; delay counted once; recovery is conformant; evidence separates simulated, digital-output and acoustic results.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Truthful source/output fidelity
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Original high-rate source deliberately transcoded upstream; local bypass and DSP cases.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Inspect GUI/API signal path and preservation status before and after sync adjustment or gain changes.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Original metadata never substitutes for received format; transformations visible; unknown upstream/hardware facts remain unknown.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Queue authority
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Active Music Assistant stream and an existing local queue.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Issue next/seek from GUI and CLI; leave and rejoin network playback; inspect both queue identities.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Supported commands routed to server; local queue is retained separately; no divergent shadow streaming queue.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Network source abuse and authorization
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Malformed protocol corpus, disallowed URL origins and unpaired peers.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Attempt unauthorized controls, forbidden URI schemes, redirects to forbidden destinations, oversized messages and stale session replay.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Blocked with bounded resources and no secret/file disclosure; explicitly authorized LAN Music Assistant URLs still function.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Backend negotiation
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Named macOS/Core Audio and Linux/ALSA machines and DACs; supported/unsupported formats.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Enumerate, open, inspect actual mode, play, close and reopen; test busy-device, unplug and stale saved-profile conditions.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Requested vs actual format and evidence recorded; strict failures do not silently use mixers/converters; advertised capability is not marked measured.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Shared Linux compatibility route
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Qualified PipeWire desktop configuration with another application playing.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Play through the system route, change server rate and switch to direct output.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Shared playback works with truthful transformations/unknowns; direct mode failure is explained; no automatic system-service termination.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Capability evidence invalidation
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Device record with test evidence and changed OS/backend/device fingerprint fixtures.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Change relevant environment inputs and reload the profile; initiate a user-approved capability test.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Old verification becomes stale; non-invasive checks are distinguished from emitted-signal tests; no audible automatic probe.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Graph compiler validity
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Valid branched/matrix graphs plus cycles, invalid domains, excessive graphs and unsupported nodes.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Validate and compile each; inspect plan, resource budget, latency and required conversions.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Valid graph scheduled deterministically; invalid graphs rejected before activation with actionable node/edge errors.

acceptance_scenarios.title: PEQ and gain numerics
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Independent analytical biquad reference; impulse, sweep, DC and limit-value fixtures.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Render filters at qualified rates, compare frequency response and finite output, and update coefficients during playback.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Meets stated numerical tolerances; invalid frequencies/Q/gains rejected; coefficient changes follow the tested transition policy.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Convolution correctness
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Impulse identity, short direct-convolution reference, long stereo correction filters and rate-mismatch fixture.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Compare partitioned output, latency and tail to reference; process silence; import incompatible-rate and measurement-IR files.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Matches stated tolerances and channel order; no hidden normalization; incompatible/ambiguous assets require rejection or explicit conversion.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Resampling qualification
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Fixed and asynchronous rate pairs, impulses, sweeps, out-of-band tones and deterministic drift.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Measure gain, passband, alias rejection, sample accounting, latency and ratio control for every exposed preset.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Each preset meets its declared measured envelope; no unsupported claims of algorithm equivalence or audible superiority.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Branch latency alignment
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Parallel paths with known integer and supported fractional latency differences.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Inject an impulse, merge branches and change one path latency under the allowed reconfiguration policy.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Correct alignment within declared precision; unsupported alignment rejected; phase response is not mislabeled as a scheduling offset.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Atomic graph/profile changes
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Running graph; competing controllers; a replacement needing more resources than available.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Prepare/commit two revisions concurrently, inject failure during preparation and observe transition behavior.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: At most one valid revision commits; stale command rejected; old working graph retained; no real-time resource destruction or unsafe gain jump.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Correction import and provenance
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Known REW/AutoEq text subsets and FIR WAV fixtures, unknown fields and hostile file paths.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Import, preview, export and reimport; compare coefficients, preamp, units, sample rate, metadata and hashes.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Supported meaning preserved; unsupported content reported; no execution/network fetch from profiles; measured room IR not assumed to be correction.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Unsafe DSP rejection
acceptance_scenarios.setup: NaN/Inf and unstable coefficients, excessive gain/resource demands and malformed assets.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Attempt activation and inject non-finite runtime output from a test node.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Invalid plans rejected; runtime faults cause safe stop/mute; protective filters are never silently bypassed; no unbounded resource growth.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Latency modes and sustained playback
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Committed reference hardware, baseline graphs, stress workloads and memory budgets.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Run stated endurance/performance suites, switch modes and request a graph outside the mode budget.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Meets declared performance gates; reports latency and underruns; refuses incompatible choices instead of changing DSP invisibly.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Volume policy across every controller
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Fixed/hardware/software profiles; UPnP/Sendspin mapping fixtures; DSD and PCM paths.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Apply volume/mute concurrently, reconnect hardware, attempt profile-import escalation and issue maximum remote volume.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Consistent caps and mute semantics; no duplicate gain; readback uncertainty visible; incompatible DSD gain refused; no fixed-output escalation.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Privacy and local-first operation
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Network blocked; secrets and private paths in test state.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Play local files offline, inspect outbound connections, export default diagnostics and try cross-user local IPC.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Local playback needs no account; no unsolicited upload; diagnostics redact secrets; other users cannot control the engine by default.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Profiles and deterministic association
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Several DAC identities and headphone/speaker setups sharing one DAC.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Switch devices/setups, resolve overlapping bindings and round-trip a profile with correction assets.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Predictable selection with explanation; ambiguous hardware requires manual setup selection; gain policy survives export/import.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Receipts, concurrency and slow clients
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Two controllers, duplicate request IDs, disconnects and backpressured event consumers.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Issue commands, replay retries, overflow telemetry queues and reconnect using cursors/snapshots.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: At-most-once mutation within documented dedupe window; applied/failure state distinct from acceptance; event gaps recover without blocking playback.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Desktop usability parity
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Packaged macOS and Linux applications on qualified systems.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Complete first-run device selection, local/network playback, correction import, profile switch, signal-path inspection and safe recovery without CLI.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Both GUIs cover release features with accessible controls and actual state; no unavailable future feature masquerades as functional.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Signal path accuracy
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Bypass, EQ, resampling, software/hardware gain and shared-output cases.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Compare inspector/API reports against compiled graph and backend instrumentation.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Requested/resolved/observed are distinct; all active transformations and evidence limits shown; no unsupported end-to-end verification claim.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Evidence completeness
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Requirements catalog and all release test runs.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Validate references, hashes, environments, actual results and required platform coverage.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Every in-scope requirement has passing exact evidence; blocked/not-run does not count as pass; future requirements remain clearly deferred.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Advanced transitions
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Lossless/lossy, rate-change and strict-mode fixtures.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Exercise fades/crossfades/ReplayGain and queue modes with incompatible strict policies.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Transformations disclosed, strict conflicts rejected and rate-specific gapless claims tested.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Advanced DSD/DAC processing
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Validated reference vectors, ultrasonic/noise measurements and qualified hardware.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Qualify each new modulator/correction algorithm and all mute/start/stop/failure transitions.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Declared numerical, spectral, stability and hardware limits met; no generic HQPlayer/Dirac equivalence claim.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Context-aware profiles
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Conflicting context rules, changing stream format and manual overrides.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Evaluate, preview and apply rules during playback with rapid context changes.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Deterministic priorities, bounded evaluation, no oscillation and preserved safety constraints.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Advanced audio analysis
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Synthetic known responses and calibrated loopback data.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Compare spectral/impulse results and run latency-aligned, gain-matched A/B with output provenance.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Known inputs reproduced within declared tolerances; software estimates never presented as measured DAC/room performance.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Phone measurement confidence
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Supported phones/routes, injected AGC/clipping/drift, acoustic-reference recordings and a comparison microphone.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Capture locally, upload with hashes, align/de-drift, assess confidence and generate bounded correction.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Bad captures rejected; no unsupported absolute SPL/phase claim; confidence-qualified regions only; physical before/after validation recorded.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Precision room correction
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Calibrated microphone/interface and multi-position listening-area project.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Calibrate, capture positions, create target/constraints, generate filters and measure corrected results.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Calibration provenance retained; boost/energy limits respected; before/after distinguished from prediction and reversible profile created.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Remote host and endpoint separation
acceptance_scenarios.setup: One host, two endpoint clocks, network fault proxy and authenticated controllers.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Use the same control contract remotely, negotiate endpoint formats and exercise disconnect/reconnect and grouped playback.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: No UI requirement on host; preserved safety/identity; declared timing and quality envelope met without assuming NAA interoperability.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Plugin hosting failure containment
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Test plugins with hangs, crashes, latency changes and malicious state.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Scan, instantiate, restore, process and crash plugins under the isolation policy.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Engine survives where isolation is claimed; bounded overhead; safe stop rather than unsafe correction bypass; no blanket sandbox claim.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Additional clients/platforms
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Named Windows/mobile/multichannel targets and library migration fixtures.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Repeat applicable control, output, interruption, permission, route-change and persistence suites.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Support published only for exercised features/platforms; mobile limits and multichannel routing independently validated.

acceptance_scenarios.title: License and feature audit
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Locked dependency graph including platform/build features and bundled correction assets.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Review SPDX declarations, actual licenses, notices, modifications, source-delivery obligations and asset provenance.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: First-party MIT declaration accurate; no unreviewed restrictive feature in release; all distributed third-party obligations documented.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Release installation and rollback
acceptance_scenarios.setup: Fresh supported macOS/Linux environments and an older supported installation.
acceptance_scenarios.procedure: Install packaged GUI/CLI/host, run offline, upgrade with migration, restore backup and uninstall.
acceptance_scenarios.expected_result: Working binaries/docs and authenticated artifacts; no accidental duplicate host; user music untouched; rollback path documented and tested.
